title: Relief on the Additional Driver Charge for Drivers Named Well Ahead of Collection
content:
Naming the drivers well ahead of collection relieves the additional driver charge on a leisure agreement written on the Car Rental Rate Classes. The relief is read off the interval between the date the agreement was booked and its scheduled collection, together with whether the agreement carries a corporate programme reference.

**The relief schedule.**

| The agreement | Relieved at |
|---|---|
| Booked 21 or more days before the scheduled collection, and carrying no corporate programme reference | 15 percent |
| Booked 7 to 20 days before the scheduled collection, and carrying no corporate programme reference | 5 percent |
| Booked closer than 7 days to collection, or carrying a corporate programme reference | Nothing |

**The two parts of each condition.** Both of the first two entitlements require the interval and the absence of a corporate programme reference together. An agreement carrying a corporate programme reference is relieved at nothing however far ahead it was booked; an agreement carrying none, but booked fewer than 7 days before collection, is likewise relieved at nothing.

**Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical leisure agreements carrying no corporate programme reference.**

| Days between booking and scheduled collection | Relieved at |
|---|---|
| 22 | 15 percent |
| 21 | 15 percent |
| 20 | 5 percent |
| 8 | 5 percent |
| 7 | 5 percent |
| 6 | Nothing |
| 0 | Nothing |

The interval is counted in days from the date the agreement was booked to its scheduled collection, and a figure standing exactly on a threshold falls in the band that threshold opens: exactly 21 days is relieved at 15 percent, and exactly 7 days at 5 percent.
